Secondly, with the remarkable progress of multimodal AI (Radford et al., 2021) and diffusion models (Ho et al., 2020), text-guided image content AI generation has made significant progress. The key driving factor is the large-scale datasets of billions of text-image pairs obtained from the Internet. Recent works have emerged that guide 3D modeling optimization by leveraging the prior of a pre-trained text-to-image generation model.

CraftsMan (Li et al., 2024b) leverages a 3D native diffusion model and a normal-based geometry refiner to generate high-fidelity 3D geometries with regular mesh topologies and detailed surfaces, supporting interactive refinement and enhancing the applicability of text-to-3D generation. VPP (Qi et al., 2024) is a progressive generation method that achieves efficient and high-quality multi-category 3D shape generation through Voxel-Point Progressive Representation (VPP), and supports various 3D downstream tasks.

Points-to-3D (Yu et al., 2023c) framework achieves view-consistent and shape-controllable text-to-3D generation by introducing sparse 3D points and leveraging the knowledge from both 2D and 3D diffusion models. GSGEN (Chen et al., 2023d) method combines Gaussian Splatting with a progressive optimization strategy to address issues such as inaccurate geometry and lengthy generation times in text-to-3D generation methods.
